sections.heading: New Features
items: The Amazon Creators API card now takes the official Creator API credentials (Credential ID, Secret, and Version) instead of the older Product Advertising API keys, and warns you if you paste the wrong kind of key

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: The Typical length stat on product pages now comes from the real runtimes of the videos in the carousel, and stays hidden when there are too few to be trustworthy
The Creators API setup video on the settings page plays again instead of showing an error

sections.heading: Other Notable Changes
items: Creator Connections and SPCC status now lives at the bottom of the Product snapshot card, and each program always shows enrolled, available, or not available once its list is downloaded

sections.heading: New Features
items: A guided setup walkthrough opens on first install and can be replayed any time from the Setup guide link in the popup
Your storefront handle is filled in automatically the first time you visit your Creator Hub, so you never have to type it
Settings sync with the desktop app: pairing fills in empty fields on both sides, and a Sync now button reconciles the rest
The popup can be resized by dragging its corner, and it remembers the size you choose
The Creators API setup video now plays right on the settings card where you paste your keys

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: The Send to app panel now tells you the desktop app is not paired yet instead of showing buttons that do nothing

sections.heading: Other Notable Changes
items: The popup side menu scrolls on its own and uses shorter labels so every item fits on one line

sections.heading: New Features
items: Product pages show an Enrolled badge when you are already accepted into a Creator Connections or SPCC campaign for that item, along with your accepted rate and earnings per click
A welcome page opens right after a fresh install to help you get set up
A friendly community reminder a few days after install explains that the Facebook group is for tips and wins, with a Report a bug button that takes issues straight to Feedback Butler

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Sending feedback from the extension is more reliable

sections.heading: New Features
items: Money signals now appear on the Amazon Today's Deals grid, including Coupons, Lightning Deals, and Outlet, with the same Butler Score, verdict, commission, and sorting tools as search results
When The Butler's Brief cannot be written, Campaign Butler now explains that connecting an OpenAI key gets you a full brief and offers a shortcut to settings

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: The Butler's Brief now recovers when the first AI provider fails, and shows a short reason when a brief still cannot be written
Video Money badges are back on the redesigned Creator Hub Manage videos page, and the page no longer freezes while your storefront loads
The popup no longer crashes when your product lists cannot be loaded

sections.heading: New Features
items: What's New: after the extension updates, you now get a quick note of what changed, right on the page and in the popup, including any issues you reported that we fixed
Campaign Butler: a per-campaign verdict panel that tells you at a glance whether a Creator Connections campaign is worth your time
Last Call Butler: a fill meter and a watch bell so you can jump on campaigns before they fill up

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: The Connect buttons in the popup stay in view, and the two-step sync is easier to follow
Amazon Creators API (PA-API) Test Connection now explains exactly what went wrong instead of failing silently
The extension now activates on tabs you already had open when it installs or updates, so you do not have to reload

sections.heading: Other Notable Changes
items: Link Butler now shows the product and campaign behind each branded link
Book a call shows a friendly timezone name next to the technical id
